description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of the 'git rebase' command, specifically its handling of incompatible options. It sets up test cases, executes git commands, and verifies that certain flag combinations fail as expected.

methods.name: test_rebase_am_only
methods.description: A function that tests whether specific rebase options are incompatible with various other rebase options or configurations, ensuring rebase warns and aborts when incompatible combinations are used.
